Aisha Patel: Quick planning thread — SolaceThera asked for a micro-bootcamp next week: 2x30min hands-on office hours + a 30min walkthrough. Need facilitator, lab owner, and a prework checklist. Who can run?
Tom Nguyen: I can facilitate. Wed 10am PT or Thu 9am PT preferred. EMEA folks, flag conflicts.
Priya Rao: Wed 10am PT conflicts with EMEA all-hands. Thu 9am PT works for me.
Jorge Alvarez: I can own the lab materials and prework. Draft agenda: ```- 10m intro/expectations
- 30m guided lab (migration -> Redwood Dedicated)
- 20m troubleshooting + pattern Q/A
- 30m paired lab signups/followups```
Liam Scott: :eyes: Heads-up — CSM flagged SolaceThera as medium renewal risk (low recent usage). Recommend AE join and we surface a small adoption incentive. @Nora Chen can you join the session? Also we need to capture feedback via a short form.
Nora Chen: I can join Thu 9am PT. I'll bring the usage dashboard and renewal notes.
Megan-bot: Quick poll — best slot for facilitators/AE: react :thumbsup: Thu 9am PT, :raised_hands: Wed 10am PT, :thinking_face: Fri 11am PT
Aisha Patel: Poll leaning toward Thu 9am PT + Nora confirmed. Locking Thu 9am PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/example. Prework: light runbook + dataset download. Jorge — can you post the lab repo and prework script by EOD Tue? Action items: Jorge: lab + prework by EOD Tue; Nora: usage dashboard + renewal talking points; Priya: run a 15-min dry run with Jorge Wed 11am PT; Aisha: send calendar invite and shared doc.
Tom Nguyen: If renewal risk is trending up, I can draft a one-pager with suggested incentives and success metrics to show during the session.
Priya Rao: Also adding a 3-question NPS-style form to capture immediate feedback and training gaps. Will draft and share.
Jorge Alvarez: Repo posted: https://git.redwood/solacethera/microbootcamp — prework script at /prework/setup.sh (run: `./prework/setup.sh`). I've added a small sample dataset and troubleshooting tips in README.
Aisha Patel: Nice, thanks Jorge. Marking as scheduled and tagging for a final dry run on Fri AM. I'll capture attendee list (customer CSM will share). :rocket: 
Liam Scott: I'll monitor usage metrics post-session and follow up with AE + CSM if adoption signals remain weak.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. Closing planning thread — will post calendar and notes shortly.
